title: Design System: May Team Realtors Cinematic Homepage

display.purpose: Hero and major section statements over film and dark editorial surfaces.

headline.purpose: Thick service names and secondary structural headings.

title.purpose: Jack May phone and email links.

body.purpose: Readable service, process, and narrative copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase chapter indices, status, navigation, and compact actions.

mobile-display.purpose: Readable phone-sized film statements without changing desktop display lettering.

shadows.name: navigation-float
shadows.purpose: Keeps the fixed header readable above moving property footage.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Gives primary May red controls physical weight.

shadows.name: service-block
shadows.purpose: Separates thick service cards from the dark section ground.

shadows.name: founder-frame
shadows.purpose: Reserves the strongest content shadow for Jack May's portrait.

shadows.name: identity-glow
shadows.purpose: Separates the background-free warm-light mark from the particle field without introducing a container.

motion.name: standard-state
motion.purpose: Button colors, shadows, and compact state changes.

motion.name: cinematic-resolve
motion.purpose: Resolves current film-beat copy from blur and displacement.

motion.name: mark-arrive
motion.purpose: Resolves the background-free identity mark from a soft blur without rotating it.

motion.name: particle-breathe
motion.purpose: Varies the opacity and scale of the 44 independent halo particles.

motion.name: particle-release
motion.purpose: Scatters the asymmetric particle field outward as the property film appears.

motion.name: loader-dissolve
motion.purpose: Cross-dissolves the loader through blur and slight expansion into the opening film.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively disables animation and transition while preserving the static experience.

components.name: May Team Transparent Mark
components.description: The transparent May Team artwork rendered as warm light directly against the dark world, with no plate or image background.
components.css: .ds-logo-mark { display: block; width: 172px; max-width: 100%; height: auto; background: transparent; filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(94%) sepia(9%) saturate(391%) hue-rotate(332deg) brightness(105%) contrast(95%) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgb(182 22 54 / 36%)); }

components.name: Particle Dissolve Loader
components.description: The background-free May Team mark held still inside a deterministic 44-particle asymmetric halo that scatters into film.
components.css: .ds-particle-loader { position: relative; display: grid; width: min(100%, 640px); aspect-ratio: 1.7; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%, rgb(182 22 54 / 22%), transparent 31%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, #211114 0, #0b0709 62%, #030203 100%); } .ds-particle-loader__cloud, .ds-particle-loader__bloom { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-particle-loader__bloom { inset: 31% 24%; background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgb(182 22 54 / 28%), transparent 68%); filter: blur(22px); } .ds-particle-loader__particle { position: absolute; top: calc(50% + var(--y)); left: calc(50% + var(--x)); width: var(--s); height: var(--s); border-radius: 999px; background: #c71f3f; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgb(199 31 63 / 92%), 0 0 24px rgb(182 22 54 / 44%); opacity: 0.32; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.62); animation: ds-particle-breathe 1.8s ease-in-out var(--d) infinite alternate; } .ds-particle-loader__particle--cream { background: #f1d9c6; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgb(241 217 198 / 84%), 0 0 22px rgb(241 217 198 / 30%); } .ds-particle-loader img { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: min(66%, 590px); height: auto; filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(94%) sepia(9%) saturate(391%) hue-rotate(332deg) brightness(105%) contrast(95%) drop-shadow(0 24px 64px rgb(0 0 0 / 76%)) drop-shadow(0 0 34px rgb(182 22 54 / 28%)); transition: opacity 720ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 720ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 720ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-particle-loader:hover .ds-particle-loader__particle { animation: ds-particle-release 680ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards; } .ds-particle-loader:hover img { opacity: 0; filter: blur(7px) drop-shadow(0 0 48px rgb(182 22 54 / 48%)); transform: scale(1.055); } @keyframes ds-particle-breathe { from { opacity: 0.24; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.5); } to { opacity: 0.94; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.24); } } @keyframes ds-particle-release { to { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) scale(0.12); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-particle-loader__particle { animation: none; } .ds-particle-loader img { transition: none; } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive listing, profile, and final-action control.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; color: #fff9f4; background: #b61636; box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / 34%); font: 850 0.67rem/1.2 "Manrope Momentum", "Archivo Momentum", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #d22b4a; box-shadow: 0 20px 46px rgb(0 0 0 / 34%); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e8c89d; outline-offset: 4px; background: #d22b4a; } .ds-arrow { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-arrow::before { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 1px; width: 15px; height: 2px; content: ""; background: currentColor; transform: rotate(-45deg); } .ds-arrow::after { position: absolute; top: 1px; right: 1px; width: 7px; height: 7px; content: ""; border-top: 2px solid currentColor; border-right: 2px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis contact action beside the primary red route.
components.css: .ds-button-text { display: inline-flex; min-height: 58px; padding: 0 18px; align-items: center; color: #faf6ef; background: transparent; font: 850 0.67rem/1.2 "Manrope Momentum", "Archivo Momentum", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: rgb(241 217 198 / 50%); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 8px; transition: color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-text:hover { color: #f1d9c6; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-text:focus-visible { color: #f1d9c6; outline: 3px solid #e8c89d; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: A thick square route into search, valuation, or property management.
components.html: 01Search homesRefine the live May Team listing search.
components.css: .ds-service-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0, 1fr) 56px; gap: 24px; min-height: 220px; padding: 38px 34px; align-items: center; color: #faf6ef; background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgb(51 18 25 / 94%), rgb(17 9 12 / 94%)); border: 2px solid rgb(241 217 198 / 18%); border-left-color: #b61636; box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%); text-decoration: none; transition: color 240ms ease, padding 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 240ms ease; } .ds-service-card:hover { padding-right: 42px; padding-left: 42px; color: #f1d9c6; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(182 22 54 / 20%), rgb(241 217 198 / 4%)); } .ds-service-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e8c89d; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-service-number { align-self: start; padding-top: 8px; color: #e8c89d; font: 850 0.68rem/1.2 "Manrope Momentum", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-service-card strong { display: block; font: 900 clamp(2.2rem, 4.3vw, 5rem)/0.92 "Unbounded Momentum", "Archivo Momentum", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-service-card small { display: block; max-width: 48ch; margin-top: 18px; color: #c7b9b5; font: 400 0.95rem/1.58 "Manrope Momentum", sans-serif; } .ds-service-arrow { width: 17px; height: 17px; justify-self: end; border-top: 2px solid #e8c89d; border-right: 2px solid #e8c89d; transform: rotate(-45deg); }

components.name: Cinematic Navigation
components.description: The fixed dark broker-led bar that preserves logo, context, and one search action.
components.html: LOUISVILLE · BROKER-OWNER LEDSEARCH HOMES
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 286px) 1fr auto; min-height: 76px; padding: 8px 9px 8px 16px; align-items: center; color: #faf6ef; background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgb(11 7 9 / 94%), rgb(35 15 19 / 86%)); border: 1px solid rgb(241 217 198 / 20%); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgb(0 0 0 / 34%); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(125%); font-family: "Manrope Momentum", sans-serif; } .ds-navigation-brand { display: block; width: 172px; max-width: 100%; height: auto; background: transparent; filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(94%) sepia(9%) saturate(391%) hue-rotate(332deg) brightness(105%) contrast(95%) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgb(182 22 54 / 36%)); } .ds-navigation-meta { justify-self: center; color: rgb(250 246 239 / 58%); font-size: 0.58rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-navigation a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; align-items: center; color: #fff9f4; background: #b61636; font-size: 0.67rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-navigation a:hover { background: #d22b4a; } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e8c89d; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Journey Step
components.description: The compact chapter marker mirrored against the scroll-directed film.
components.css: .ds-journey-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 20px; width: 174px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; color: rgb(250 246 239 / 42%); font: 850 0.58rem/1.2 "Manrope Momentum", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-align: right; text-decoration: none; } .ds-journey-step::after { width: 9px; height: 9px; justify-self: end; content: ""; background: #0b0709; border: 1px solid rgb(250 246 239 / 64%); border-radius: 50%; transition: background 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-journey-step:hover, .ds-journey-step.is-active { color: #faf6ef; } .ds-journey-step.is-active::after { background: #c71f3f; border-color: #c71f3f; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgb(199 31 63 / 66%); transform: scale(1.35); } .ds-journey-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e8c89d; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Founder Portrait Frame
components.description: The square warm-stone and deep-red frame reserved for Jack May's portrait.
components.css: .ds-founder-frame { position: relative; width: min(100%, 560px); margin: 0; padding: 22px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #e8c89d, #8d112b); box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgb(0 0 0 / 46%); } .ds-founder-frame::after { position: absolute; inset: 38px -28px -28px 38px; z-index: -1; content: ""; border: 2px solid rgb(232 200 157 / 45%); } .ds-founder-frame img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.82) contrast(1.06); }

narrative.overview:
The system behaves like a rain-dark real-estate film directed by the visitor. Large, compressed Unbounded statements sit over a full-viewport concept-property sequence while May Team red, warm stone, and near-black layers keep the experience tied to the brokerage rather than to a generic luxury aesthetic.

The material language is deliberately weighty: thick square service blocks, dark translucent navigation, substantial controls, and a framed founder portrait. The transparent May Team source artwork is rendered as a warm-light mark directly against the dark stage, without a containing card or visible image background. In the opening gate, an asymmetric field of 44 independent particles condenses around the fixed mark, then scatters and blurs into the first property-film frame.
keyCharacteristics: Background-free logo reveal with a broken 44-particle halo and film cross-dissolve.
Near-black and wine surfaces with rare, decisive May red actions.
Oversized Unbounded display type paired with clear Manrope body copy.
Square, thick containers with ambient depth and restrained warm-stone linework.
A human founder section that makes Jack May the accountable next step.

rules.name: The Red Is an Action Rule
rules.body: Use May red for decisions, progress, and active state; broad reading surfaces remain black, wine, cream, or warm stone.

rules.name: The Background-Free Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the transparent May Team artwork as a warm-light mark directly on the dark film world. Never redraw, pixelate, place it on a card, or reintroduce a white image rectangle.

rules.name: The Monument and Guide Rule
rules.body: Unbounded states the destination; Manrope explains the route. Do not substitute a system display face or use Manrope for the major cinematic statements.

rules.name: The Weight Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Create impact through size, 700-900 variable weight, compact line-height, and shadowed contrast. Do not use gradient-clipped text, thin decorative scripts, or emoji as emphasis.

rules.name: The One Sequence Rule
rules.body: The experience moves from film to services to process to Jack May to action. Preserve that reading order even when the grid collapses.

rules.name: The Dark-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering, wash, and broad ambient shadow before adding borders. Borders remain low-contrast except for the founder portrait's deliberate warm-stone frame.

rules.name: The Broken Halo Rule
rules.body: Circular geometry communicates individual energy points, progress, or live state; it is not a generic container style, and complete rings never surround the identity mark.

rules.name: The Particle Dissolve Rule
rules.body: Keep the identity mark still while the 44-particle halo breathes, scatters, and blur-cross-dissolves into film. Never rotate the mark, use solid orbit rings, shrink the field into a circular collapse, or place the logo on a card.

rules.name: The Mobile Reading Rule
rules.body: Functional actions and film labels have a 12px floor. Mobile film headings use the mobile-display role so words remain intact, while desktop display lettering and the approved film sequence stay unchanged. Direct contact links provide 44px targets.

dos: Do preserve the self-hosted Unbounded and Manrope roles and their strong weight contrast.
Do use the transparent May Team artwork directly on the dark world with the established warm-light treatment and no containing surface.
Do keep the logo fixed while the deterministic 44-particle field provides the loader's motion.
Do use thick square service blocks and substantial controls to maintain the property's architectural weight.
Do keep Jack May visible as a real person near the final decision point.
Do preserve keyboard focus, the static poster fallback, and the reduced-motion freeze state.
Do draw interface arrows and indicators with CSS or SVG geometry.
donts: Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as interface icons or decorative website content.
Don't redraw, pixelate, place the May Team logo inside a white box, or add a card behind it.
Don't bring back solid orbit rings, vinyl-like rotation, or a circular collapse in the loader.
Don't use gradient-clipped headline text, rounded generic SaaS cards, or a system display font.
Don't let red become a broad default background when it is needed to identify action and state.
Don't imply that the concept-property film is an active listing.
